analyst_view.overall: Union Saint-Gilloise are 4th in the Europa League with 10 points and back on top of the Belgian league after a late 1-0 win at Kortrijk on Sunday; David Hubert's side play this home game at Den Dreef in Leuven. Lech Poznan lead the Polish league (they won 1-0 at GKS Katowice on Sunday) but have only 1 point from four European games, and coach Niels Frederiksen has said he wants at least one win from this game and Ferencvaros, so no big rotation is expected. Lech are short on the wings: Patrik Wålemark was injured with Sweden, and Daniel Håkans hurt his knee in Sunday's warm-up, though Frederiksen expects him to train on Tuesday. The brief lists no missing players and no referee; news on Union's squad was thin, so the view rests mostly on form and context.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals, 2.7 for Union, with small momentum nudges for both. Lech score freely at home in Poland but have struggled in Europe, and losing winger Wålemark (with Håkans doubtful) blunts them a little, though Frederiksen said the attack held up without them at Katowice; Union were tight at Kortrijk but are strong at home. Nothing clear enough to move, so I stay at 3.5.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.2 corners, already trimming Union for their low recent corner count (-7%). Lech without wingers Wålemark and possibly Håkans may get forward wide less often, but their side is already small (3.1), so I stay at about 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards, already lowered for both sides' calm recent records (-3% Union, -7% Lech). Lech need points, but they are a passing side rather than a rough one, and the referee is not named yet, so I stay at about 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers expect 30.8 shots, with Union expected to dominate (21.3). Lech concede a lot of shots in Europe and Frederiksen is not expected to rotate heavily with points needed, which is the open game the numbers already assume, so I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.6 shots on target, already adding for Union's accurate recent shooting (+11%). Union hit the woodwork and had a goal ruled out at Kortrijk, so the chances are coming; nothing new points either way and I stay at about 11.6.
